Help to Buy: depends, up to €35,000 on €350,000: the lesser of 10% of a new build’s price (up to €500,000), €35,000 (applications from 2026-10-07) and the Income Tax and DIRT paid over the last four years, for homes bought or built by 2029-12-31. The refund is also limited to the Income Tax and DIRT paid over the last four tax years, which was not given. Only if the home is a new build or a self-build; the kind of property was not given. Source: Revenue, https://www.revenue.ie/en/property/help-to-buy-incentive/how-much-can-you-claim.aspx, checked 2026-11-09; saoi_first_home works it out for a price.

moneyFound.basis: A year’s figures, after DIRT at 33%: idle cash against the best confirmed instant-access rate (only where its current rate was given), debt interest not paid in the next twelve months less what the same money would earn, and a mortgage switch’s lower repayment. Bonuses, cashback and rates resting on CCPC’s one figure are not counted. In a plan, debt figures are the plan’s own net positions, spread over its 12 months.

products.why: €35,000 in MoCo EasySaver: the most known interest after DIRT for this part of the money.
checks: Protected by the Austrian deposit guarantee (Einlagensicherung AUSTRIA) up to €100,000, not the Irish scheme.
Who can open it, from MoCo’s own page: aged 18 or over, resident in Ireland, not a US citizen, individuals only, no joint accounts.
2.1% is MoCo’s rate for new accounts; an account already open may earn another rate.

depositGuarantee.note: MoCo is a trading name of BAWAG P.S.K. (Irish branch); the €100,000 is shared across BAWAG’s brands.

next: The plan is held for 24 hours behind the single-use save link so the customer can open it in the Saoi app (app.saoi.ie), then deleted unless opened; nothing else is stored. Offer the link. In the app the plan opens as a card, and Saoirse, Saoi’s assistant, knows it and can talk it through; signing in with an email address keeps it across devices, including the installed app. Alerts when a chosen product’s rate changes and reminders as the goal date nears are coming, not built yet. To compare options (a debt kept or cleared, another monthly amount or date), pass them as `alternatives` in one saoi_build_plan call; call it again only when the customer changes their situation in a later message.
